# 根据某图片获取对应的人物信息
##### 简要描述

- | 字段 | 类型 | 描述 | 是否必须 |
| --- | --- | --- | ---- |
| ItemIndex | integer | 人脸库中的图片和对应的人物信息<span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">的索引，从0开始自增</span> | 是 |
| PersonName | string | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">人名，最大长度32，不可为空</span>，中文字符使用utf-8格式<span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)"></span> | 是 |
| ImageName | string | 图片名，最大长度256，不可为空，中文字符使用utf-8格式 | 是 |
| Remark | boolean | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是否标记；false-否，true-是</span> | 是 |

![image.png](data:image/png;base64,)

``` http
PUT /FaceGroup/ImagePersonMap HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46
Content-Type: application/xml
User-Agent: PostmanRuntime/7.42.0
Accept: */*
Cache-Control: no-cache
Postman-Token: fb18fe4b-2208-4862-9bc4-ea0d4f7d6f98
Host: 192.168.6.150
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Connection: keep-alive
Content-Length: 307

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<ImagePersonMapList Version="1.0">
<ImagePersonMap Version="1.0">
<ItemIndex>0</ItemIndex>
<ImageName>证件照</ImageName>
<PersonName>zhangsan</PersonName>
<Remark>true</Remark>
</ImagePersonMap>
</ImagePersonMapList>


HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Server: CGI/2.0.5
Content-Type: application/xml
Connection: close
Content-Length: 191

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<ResponseStatus Version="1.0">
<requestURL>/FaceGroup/ImagePersonMap</requestURL>
<statusCode>0</statusCode>
<message />
</ResponseStatus>
```

##### 请求URL

 - `/FaceGroup/ImagePersonMap` 

##### 请求方式

- put
 
##### 成功返回示例  
```
{}

```
